title: Stop Arnaque 237: Cameroon Scam Reports Dataset
description: An open, anonymized dataset of scams reported in Cameroon: scam messages, calls and schemes reported by people through a bilingual form, public scam alerts from fact-checkers, institutions, news sites and public social media posts, a table of pseudonymized scammer numbers, and genuine operator messages for comparison. Documentation: DATASHEET.md in the repository.
